title: ControlNet (canny)
notes: ControlNet is selected by params.control_type; source_processing stays "img2img". The canny edge map keeps the anchor composition while the prompt re-themes the render. Pinned to world 1: canny is demonstrated on the photoreal courier, where an edge map has a recognisable subject to hold, and Deliberate is the SD1.5 model this recipe is known good on.
